Container.Name: webdash

Branch.TagDescription: Latest stable release / Aktuelle stabile Version

Container.Overview:
Lightweight, self-hosted server dashboard. Discovers Docker containers automatically, shows live status, and provides a clean start page for all your web apps and services.
Schlankes, selbstgehostetes Server-Dashboard. Erkennt Docker-Container automatisch, zeigt Live-Status und bietet eine zentrale Startseite fuer alle Webanwendungen und Dienste.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface / Port fuer die Weboberflaeche

Config.Name: Docker Mode
Config.Description: Enable Docker container discovery / Docker-Container-Erkennung aktivieren

Config.Name: Host IP
Config.Description: Host IP for container URLs. Leave empty for auto-detect. / Host-IP fuer Container-URLs. Leer lassen fuer automatische Erkennung.

Config.Name: Hostname
Config.Description: Display name in dashboard (default: system hostname) / Anzeigename im Dashboard (Standard: System-Hostname)

Config.Name: Scan Directory
Config.Description: Additional directory to scan for web apps (requires path mapping below) / Zusaetzliches Verzeichnis fuer Webanwendungen (erfordert Pfad-Mapping unten)

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent config and data / Persistente Konfiguration und Daten

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket for container discovery (read-only) / Docker-Socket fuer Container-Erkennung (nur lesend)
